hooks.name: Full verification after a spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task is marked completed, runs the project's declared checks end to end: API unittest suite, compileall, frontend tests, tsc build and oxlint.

action.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s packages/api/tests -t . && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q packages\api\walking_skeleton packages\api\app.py && npm.cmd --prefix frontend test && npm.cmd --prefix frontend run build && npm.cmd --prefix frontend run lint
